method: Individual visual inspection of each page PNG at original resolution, rendered at 150 dpi by system Poppler and viewed with view_image(detail="original"). Checked equations and tables, margins, overlaps, clipping, headings, footers and density.

defects.description: The final Chapter 22 sentence spills to a separate page containing only one line. Move this line back onto the preceding page through a small prose or layout adjustment.

other_pages: All other nineteen inspected pages have clear equations and tables, no clipping or overlap, and acceptable density.
